# Pull request review 🛠️

## What changed?

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Why?

Explain the reason and any compatibility considerations.

## Validation

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Relevant behavior checks used disposable files, stubbed commands, or mocked requests
- [ ] Updated usage and documentation match the source

State additional checks and any runtime or platform behavior left unverified.

## Private-data check

- [ ] No API keys, webhook URLs, tokens, or real credentials
- [ ] No private configuration, personal paths, or unredacted logs
- [ ] No unrelated changes or removed author attribution

## Review notes

Describe anything the maintainer should focus on. Leave this PR open for owner review.
